contexts.text: Evil Spirits excite all the wrong deeds of a man... and condemn him; than which nothing is more delightful to them...
Shall his blood be shed = his condemnation.
The internal sense is, that he who bears hatred against his neighbour, is thereby condemned to Hell.

When charity is extinguished, man is left to his own proprium... and when external bonds are loosed, as takes place in the other life, he rushes into the most cruel and filthy things, thus into self-condemnation.
When they who are in no charity come into the other life... they are constantly animated with a disposition to condemn, punish, and torment.
Evil Spirits never excite anything but man's evils and falsities, and condemn him.
It is the internal idolatrous worships which condemn man; the external ones not so much; the more interior and idolatrous worship is, the more it condemns; but the more exterior it is, the less.
Truths condemn everyone to Hell...
With the man who is judged to death, each and all things condemn him...
Hence it is evident that works are what save man, and what condemn man; namely, good works save him, and evil ones condemn him.
Wherefore, he despises others in comparison with himself, nay, he even condemns them...
These evils condemn, but not to such a degree as evils from an evil origin...
It is according to order, that those will be saved who have lived well, and those condemned who have lived evilly.

The word of them both shall come even to God, whom God shall condemn () = inquiry and judging between them by truth... To condemn = to judge between them, and award the penalty to him who has done wrong.
Everyone with whom the Church is, is saved, and everyone with whom the Church is not, is condemned.
That he who condemns (these two essentials of the New Church), shall be in like manner condemned. Signified.
That those who have not lived according to the Lord's precepts in the Word, and have not believed in the Lord, are condemned. Signified.
(In this case) those would be condemned who are condemned in the world.
On those who condemn others within themselves, and utter different things with the mouth.
On the devastation and condemnation of the evil; that they are effected by themselves.
That we are not to think evilly about good and truth, is meant by, Judge not, that ye be not judged; condemn not, that ye be not condemned ().
To condemn Him, and to deliver Him to the gentiles () = to adjudge the Divine truth and the Divine good to Hell, and to deliver over to the evils and falsities thence.
